info.title: FGA private-MVP HTTP API design projection
info.description: Derived, non-normative OpenAPI projection of the planned private-MVP routes. It is not generated from a production FGA API backend and is not executable release evidence. Apply each operation's x-fga-source contracts and the repository documentation-authority hierarchy.

servers.description: Selected private production origin; deployment evidence remains pending.

head.summary: Read startup status without a body
Read liveness status without a body

get.summary: Read the installation represented by the Bearer credential
Read one keyset page from the current writable-group snapshot
Read one advisory page of public photos for the linked owner

post.summary: Create or refresh a verified binding for an existing public photo

get.summary: Read one keyset page from a fresh Flickr membership observation

post.summary: Create one short-lived service-signed direct-upload envelope

put.summary: Idempotently bind and verify a definitive Flickr upload result

get.summary: Read advisory candidates for a possible ambiguous upload
get.description: The route, authority, privacy boundary, and returned candidate fields are designed. Exact pagination parameter and response-envelope names are not yet closed, so no invented query or response schema appears here.

200.description: Bounded no-store advisory candidate page; exact envelope remains to be closed.

put.summary: Idempotently bind a photographer-selected ambiguous-upload candidate

post.summary: Durably accept one bounded photo/group intent batch
post.description: This handler commits all accepted intents before returning and makes no Flickr write inline. Zero groups are invalid, the request is never sliced, and an existing permanent exact-pair block cannot be bypassed.

get.summary: Read sanitized deployment and database checks

post.summary: Create one transaction-bound recent Google reauthentication
Idempotently revoke the current administrative session

get.summary: List display-safe sessions for the exact principal

post.summary: Revoke every other administrative session for the principal
Start or replace the private Flickr OAuth 1.0a grant
Disconnect the linked Flickr grant locally and pause writes

get.summary: List the authenticated user's display-safe Plugin Code records
get.description: Ownership is selected only by the internal fgaUserId in the validated FGA browser session; email is never an ownership selector. The audit event must be durable before a successful response releases metadata.

post.summary: Create one Plugin Code and reveal its plaintext exactly once

patch.summary: Move one active Plugin Code record to the revoked state

get.summary: Read sanitized linked-user and deployment Flickr write gates

post.summary: Attempt non-mutating verification and compare-and-set gate resume
post.description: This operation offers no bypass. It resumes only after the controlling contract's verification succeeds against the expected revision.

get.summary: Read a bounded reverse-chronological audit-event page
get.description: The collection uses an opaque cursor and excludes secret values and request bodies. Exact query and representation schemas remain to be closed.

installationBearer.bearerFormat: canonical grouped Crockford Base32 FGA installation credential
installationBearer.description: Exact 64-character installation-scoped Bearer credential from ADR 0044. The server-assigned lrc_plugin class has an exhaustive method/path allowlist.

browserSessionCookie.name: __Host-fga_admin
browserSessionCookie.description: Google-authenticated opaque server-side FGA browser session. The cookie is host-only, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, and has a non-sliding 24-hour absolute lifetime. State-changing operations also require exact-origin and session-bound CSRF validation; administrative routes apply their separate owner policy after session authentication.

SnapshotRevision.name: snapshot_revision
SnapshotRevision.description: Required together with after_group_id on a continuation.

ObservationRevision.name: observation_revision
ObservationRevision.description: Required together with after_group_id on a continuation.

AfterGroupId.name: after_group_id
AfterGroupId.description: Exact keyset boundary returned by the prior page; paired with the applicable revision.

AdministrativeSessionPageToken.name: page_token
AdministrativeSessionPageToken.description: Opaque continuation token bound to the current FGA user and session query; conveys position only.

PluginCodeId.name: pluginCodeId
PluginCodeId.description: Opaque non-secret identifier for one Plugin Code record; never the Plugin Code, its prefix, or its digest.

PluginCodePageToken.name: page_token
PluginCodePageToken.description: Opaque continuation token from nextPageToken. It conveys position only, is bound to the authenticated user and unchanged query, and grants no authority.

PluginCodeIfMatch.name: If-Match
PluginCodeIfMatch.description: Strong validator for the current Plugin Code representation.

BrowserSessionCsrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
BrowserSessionCsrf.description: Per-session 256-bit base64url synchronizer token paired with exact-origin validation; not an authentication substitute.

NoStore.description: Every response in these private/status namespaces is non-cacheable.

RetryAfter.description: Minimum delay before the operation-specific safe retry.

Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge for installation authentication only.

ExpiredBrowserSessionCookie.description: Fixed expiration of __Host-fga_admin after durable logout revocation.

Error.description: Stable sanitized FGA error; the operation-specific contract controls retry authority.

BearerAuthenticationFailure.description: Missing authentication has an empty body and bare Bearer challenge; a presented malformed or invalid credential uses the stable sanitized error contract. No response distinguishes invalid-token causes.

BrowserSessionAuthenticationFailure.description: Non-oracular FGA browser-session JSON authentication failure; never a Bearer challenge.

HealthUnavailable.description: Startup has not established safe service yet.

HealthHeadOk.description: Coarse health success with no body.

CurrentInstallation.description: Current installation represented by the presented credential.

GroupPage.description: One keyset page from a complete current group snapshot.

ExistingPublicPhotoPage.description: One completely validated advisory Flickr photo page.

MembershipPage.description: One page from a fresh complete Flickr pool-membership observation.

UploadAuthorization.description: Sensitive one-use direct-upload signing envelope; never persisted or logged by the client.

GroupSubmissionBatch.description: Durably committed intent snapshots; not evidence that Flickr added any photo.

CurrentAdministrativeSession.description: Display-safe current-session state and the in-memory synchronizer token.

ReauthenticationTransaction.description: One five-minute GIS state/nonce transaction returned once.

AdministrativeSessionPage.description: One bounded reverse-chronological page of display-safe sessions.

NoContent.description: The requested idempotent state transition has a known durable outcome and no body.

LoggedOut.description: Durable current-session revocation committed; empty response.

FlickrAuthorizationRedirect.description: Redirect only to Flickr's fixed authorization origin.

PluginCodeCreated.description: One newly committed Plugin Code whose canonical plaintext is returned exactly once.

UnclosedAdministrativeRepresentation.description: No-store administrative result whose exact request/status/representation schema remains to be closed in the named controlling contract; this projection deliberately invents no payload.

UnclosedBrowserRepresentation.description: No-store FGA User API result whose exact request/status/representation schema remains to be closed in the named controlling contract; this projection deliberately invents no payload.

OpaqueId.description: Opaque identifier; clients do not parse, increment, or derive authority from its spelling.

Random256Base64Url.description: Canonical RFC 4648 base64url without padding for exactly 256 random bits.

PluginCodeCredential.description: ADR 0044 canonical encoding of exactly 32 random octets: 52 uppercase Crockford Base32 symbols in 13 four-symbol groups separated by ASCII hyphens. The hyphens are part of the credential; parsers perform no normalization or repair.

nextWorkNotBefore.description: Advisory database lower bound for head work at observedAt; null for a non-head or an attempt already in progress. This is not an ETA or scheduler-cadence promise.

recommendedPollAfterSeconds.description: Minimum client read interval only; never worker cadence or an ETA.
Minimum client read interval only; never worker cadence or an ETA.
